title: Concept: Rejected request body echoed in the error
description: An error payload that repeats the submitted body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The echo carries whatever the customer typed, including a password or a card number, into logs, trackers and support tickets.
applicability: Deployments that render an error payload that repeats the submitted body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The echo carries whatever the customer typed, including a password or a card number, into logs, trackers and support tickets.
